description: Confirm that a transfer arrived: the destination outlet gains the units and the transfer closes. CONFIRM WITH THE MERCHANT FIRST — this adds stock and cannot be undone from here. Only do it when they say the goods are physically there; confirming a transfer that never arrived hides a loss instead of recording one. Takes stockTransferId (from get_stock_transfer), NOT the transactionId. Only applies to a receive-transfer leg still in-transit; a transfer already completed has nothing left to receive.

stockTransferId.description: stockTransferId from get_stock_transfer — not the transactionId

name: hub_receive_stock_transfer
